Original uploader Edvvc expressly grants CC BY-SA3 in initial revision26854616; old NC tag is not the only grant. Downloaded 188298-byte original SHA-1 matches Commons. Actual Veyron Pur Sang family; unspecified target trim/year and short exterior departure remain limits. CC BY-SA3 section1(a) treats phonogram synchronization with moving images as adaptation; section4(b) ShareAlike covers that adaptation while separate collection works can retain separate licenses. A WAV-only credit does not settle the game audiovisual scope; no broad code relicense inferred. Optional project-specific audiovisual notice prepared outside shipping artifacts, NOT APPLIED. No bank or runtime mapping change. Local audio-only audition prepared from 1.000–2.350 s with unchanged pipeline, single 1.25 s / 60,044-byte band, moving-only and actual mixer checks passed. No aural approval or production integration. Subsequent actual-layer audit found no incompatible simultaneous layer: other car recordings do not play with Veyron, and visual inputs are CC BY/CC0. Main-game adaptation versus separate-work scope is still unresolved by primary guidance; user approval alone does not settle it. Do not treat Sonniss as an automatic overlap blocker. Keep local, no broad licensing approval requested.
